newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Mine kills two Bulgarians on Greek border.
newsitem.headline: Mine kills two Bulgarians on Greek border.

text.p: Two Bulgarians were killed when they strayed into an old Greek minefield while trying to cross the border with Greece illegally, the Bulgarian interior ministry said on Thursday.
The two, believed to be husband and wife, were among a group of seven people who had tried to cross into Greece on Tuesday with the help of local people-smugglers, a ministry statement said.
Three women who returned to the nearby Bulgarian town of Petrich said they believed two boys in the group had been injured in the explosion and were still on the Greek side of the border.
The ministry said the Bulgarian authorities were in touch with their Greek counterparts over the incident.
Economic hardship has encouraged many Bulgarians to seek a better life abroad but visas for European Union member states are often hard to obtain.
